name: portfolio-intelligence
objective: Continuously monitor my portfolio and relevant market developments. Investigate meaningful events, keep a concise picture of each holding in your state, and tell me when something needs my attention or action. Never trade.

routes.title: Investigate price move
routes.objective: A holding moved past its alert threshold. Find out why, judge whether it changes the thesis in your state, and notify only if it does.

routes.title: Assess news
routes.objective: News mentions a holding. Decide whether it is material; most news is not.

schedules.title: Daily portfolio brief
schedules.objective: Write a short brief of what changed today across the portfolio. Notify at info severity only if something is worth reading.

obligations.description: Portfolio picture refreshed at least daily
